---
title: "Supplementary Figure 4 - Six-month univariate comparisons"
output: html_document
---

This notebook compares selected six-month antibody features across the three
maternal vaccination-timing groups. Run `Figure_4/01_load_data.Rmd` first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "plotting_functions.R"))

stopifnot(all(vapply(
  c("temp_data", "temp_meta", "sel_feat", "neg_control_threshold"),
  exists,
  logical(1)
)))
```

## 1. Reshape measurements and test group differences

```{r statistics}
feature_data <- temp_data[, sel_feat, drop = FALSE]
feature_data <- feature_data[, !grepl("IgA|IgM|FcaR", names(feature_data)), drop = FALSE]

long_data <- feature_data %>%
  mutate(Vax_group = temp_meta$Vax_group) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(feature_data)),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "value"
  )

feature_tests <- kruskal_by_feature(long_data, group_column = "Vax_group")
long_data <- add_detection_status(long_data, neg_control_threshold)
detection_summary <- summarize_detection(long_data, group_column = "Vax_group")
```

## 2. Plot selected features

```{r plot-features}
features_to_plot <- unique(c(
  "IgG3_Spike_gamma",
  "IgG_S1",
  "IgG1_Spike_WT",
  "FcgR3B_Spike_beta",
  "FcgR3AV_Spike_WT",
  "FcgR2AR_RBD_WT",
  "IgG1_S1",
  "FcgR3B_RBD_WT",
  "FcgR2AR_Spike_alpha",
  "FcRn_RBD_gamma"
))

vax_group_colors <- ggsci::pal_simpsons()(5)
vax_colors <- c(vax_group_colors[2], vax_group_colors[1], vax_group_colors[5])

feature_plots <- setNames(lapply(features_to_plot, function(feature) {
  plot_data <- long_data[long_data$feature == feature, , drop = FALSE]

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(Vax_group, value, fill = Vax_group)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = unname(neg_control_threshold[feature]),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = vax_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Vaccine dose 1 group",
      y = "log10 (MFI)",
      title = format_feature_label(feature)
    ) +
    publication_theme(title_size = 12, axis_title_size = 10, axis_text_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
}), features_to_plot)
```

## 3. Save individual panels

```{r save-figures}
invisible(lapply(names(feature_plots), function(feature) {
  ggsave(
    output_path("Sup_Fig_4", paste0(feature, ".png")),
    feature_plots[[feature]],
    width = 3,
    height = 3,
    units = "in"
  )
}))
```
